label: pass
notes: Synthetic PASS: clear want, obstacle, relational cost.
text:
INT. ARCHIVE ROOM - NIGHT

MARA wants the affidavit before midnight. The vault LOCK clicks against her. ELI blocks the aisle with a cart.

MARA
Move. I need the file before the clerk resets the log.

ELI
If you take it, I stop being your witness.

MARA
Then you're the cost.

She yanks the drawer. Eli does not move. Mara burns the top page copy so nobody else can use her unfinished proof. The smoke alarm stays quiet. The radio on her belt chirps once.
